full_judgment: 19. More so, the abscondence of the accused though is not a ground for presumption of the guilt of the accused, but in particular circumstances it may lend support to the guilt of the accused. Abscondence of an accused person in some circumstances may not be incriminating against him in respect of his guilt but long abscondence is an important circumstance against him and furnishes corroboration of prosecution evidence under the provision laid down in section 8 of the Evidence Act.
